prompt_inputs.content: The modernist rejection of Victorian sentimentality fundamentally transformed literary aesthetics, yet this rupture paradoxically retained the very humanistic concerns it ostensibly abandoned. Similarly, the stream-of-consciousness innovations pioneered by Joyce and Woolf, while celebrated for their technical virtuosity, implicitly grapple with questions of moral responsibility and the nature of authentic selfhood—concerns that link them philosophically to existentialist thought emerging contemporaneously in Continental philosophy. The critical tendency to emphasize modernism's aesthetic autonomy obscures how these formal experiments constitute a sustained meditation on authenticity, alienation, and the possibility of meaningful human connection in an increasingly fragmented world.

prompt_inputs.content: We present a novel approach for solving the Schrödinger equation using variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) algorithms implemented on near-term intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices. We employed the simultaneous perturbational stochastic approximation (SPSA) optimizer combined with error mitigation techniques including zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) and probabilistic error cancellation (PEC) to suppress the effects of decoherence and gate infidelities on IBM Quantum and IonQ platforms. Benchmarking against classical coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD) methods demonstrates a 40% reduction in circuit depth while maintaining chemical accuracy within 1 mHartree for small molecules. Our implementation of dynamical decoupling sequences and dynamical circuit techniques further reduces noise accumulation by 60%, enabling practical applications in quantum chemistry simulation and materials discovery.
